stage: After completed learned baselines and failed AI qualification; before main generative inference
purpose: Complete outlined per-morphology reporting from saved frozen exact-synthetic matches; no new inference or replacement primary scoring.

definitions.matching: Reuse saved primary greedy matching with no rematching.
definitions.scope: Exact synthetic truth only, original morphology/domain scope; optional harmonics excluded.
definitions.malformed: Known declared morphology receives FP; unknown malformed receives its own bucket.
definitions.zero_support: Display positive reference support explicitly; no positive-class performance claim for absent morphology.
definitions.statistical_scope: Descriptive micro-counts, precision, recall, F1; no new confirmatory hypothesis.
